description: A fault on home plumbing or air equipment in, the OwnerSpec guides that explain it out: a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm chirping or beeping, a water heater popping, leaking or giving no hot water, a running toilet, a sump pump that will not start, banging pipes, condensation, a softener not using salt. Returns each guide's cited quick answer. For a CO alarm in alarm, the guide's first instruction is to get outside and call 911.

problem.description: Equipment plus what it is doing, e.g. "Kidde smoke alarm chirps twice a minute"

name: troubleshoot_home_equipment
title: Troubleshoot home equipment
